region.description: Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the [provider configuration](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#aws-configuration-reference).

namespace.description: Name of the namespace. Must be between 1 and 255 characters in length. Can consist of lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores, and must begin and end with a lowercase letter or number.

table_bucket_arn.description: ARN referencing the Table Bucket that contains this Namespace.
